title: How firefighters and volunteers supported by water planes imposed a major setback to the Gironde fire as it was about to swallow more homes
subhead: In less than two hours, the monster fire raging in southwestern France made enormous progress toward a residential area. Firefighters and local residents, with help from the air, managed to halt its progress at the very last minute.

Kush, a synthetic and highly addictive drug, devastates Sierra Leone and Liberia
subhead: 'Africa under the influence' (2/6). Sold at a low price, kush causes rapid addiction and severe, often fatal, injuries. Photographer Gaël Turine traveled to Freetown and Monrovia to document the destruction wrought by this new synthetic drug among young people in Sierra Leone and Liberia.

title: Behind Infantino's push to open FIFA to private investors
subhead: The International Federation of Association Football announced on Tuesday its intention to create a commercial company to maximize its revenues, especially from the World Cup. The move has drawn criticism, notably from UEFA, which condemned what it called the 'sale' of football.

title: Night terrors: How our half-asleep brains make us scream and move erratically
subhead: Night terrors are frightening episodes, distinct from both sleepwalking and nightmares, that occur during periods of deep, slow-wave sleep. They affect 15% of children aged 3 to 10, and 2.2% of adults.

title: The secrets of birdsong, organized by eight 'elementary' motifs
subhead: Drawing on more than 100,000 recordings, researchers have identified the eight basic motifs, including trills and whistles, that songbirds use to compose their tunes.
